goal.title: Become job-ready as a junior backend developer

task.title: Deploy a to-do REST API with create, list and delete endpoints
task.description: Build a small to-do API with POST /todos, GET /todos and DELETE /todos/{id}, write at least 3 tests, and deploy it to any free hosting.
task.why_it_matters: A deployed, tested API is the minimum portfolio piece for junior backend roles.
task.expected_result: A public URL where the 3 endpoints work, and a repository with tests and a README.

expected_output.message_to_user: I'll verify this the way a reviewer would, within what the app can do: it fetches GET /todos from your live URL once, I read the repository you upload — tests and README included — and you paste the output of a short curl session for POST, GET and DELETE, because the app can't send those requests itself. Then one question about a design choice.

methods.instructions: Submit the base URL. The app fetches GET /todos once (a public GET, no login) and passes the response on for review.
acceptance_criteria: GET /todos responds with a JSON list

methods.instructions: Upload the repository as a .zip (or the test files and the README).
acceptance_criteria: At least 3 automated tests covering create, list and delete
README explains how to run locally and lists the endpoints

methods.instructions: Paste the commands and responses of a short curl session against the live URL: POST /todos, GET /todos, DELETE /todos/{id}, then GET /todos again.
acceptance_criteria: The second GET no longer shows the deleted item

questions: What status code does DELETE return for an id that doesn't exist, and why did you choose it?

pass_criteria: Repository tests cover the three endpoints and the README lists them
The pasted session shows create and delete working on the live URL
protocol.rationale: Software is verified by running it and reading the code, not by screenshots. The live GET and the repository are checked directly; create and delete on the live service reach the navigator only as the user's pasted output, which the app cannot reproduce, so confidence is medium rather than high.
